The '''Imperial Sensor Net Complex''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Argovia]] was located near the capital, [[Argovas City]]. It was used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] to analyze data from thousands of [[sensor net]]s, ships, and [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droids]] in the [[Endocray sector/Legends|Endocray sector]]. The complex was [[Mission to Argovia|destroyed]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] by an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] strike team in order to dislocate the Imperial [[Blockade of the Endocray sector]].
